title: Farm Jersey
subtitle: Lightning-fast applications
summary: Jersey's agricultural network needed one place to manage growers, produce and grant applications. We built a portal that turned a six-week paper process into a same-day one.

sections.label: The challenge
sections.body: Applications arrived by post, moved by hand, and disappeared into filing cabinets. Growers waited weeks for answers that took minutes to make. Nobody could see where anything was.

sections.caption: The grower portal — application status at a glance.

sections.label: What we did
sections.body: One portal for growers, one dashboard for the team. Structured applications, automated checks, and a status anyone can read. No training manual required.

sections.label: The result
sections.body: Same-day decisions on standard applications. Six weeks of admin, gone. The filing cabinets are now used for biscuits.
